title: Genuine telecom plan upgrade
blurb: Airtel's store calls about a 5G plan. Sales pressure is mild, there is no threat, and she is told to decide at her convenience.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste ma'am, this is Priya calling from the Airtel store in Jubilee Hills. Is this a good time?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, your current plan is 599 per month. There's a new 5G plan at 649 with unlimited data and a free OTT subscription. Would you like me to explain?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is my number going to be disconnected if I don't change?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not at all, ma'am. Your existing plan continues as it is. This is only an offer; you can ignore it if you're not interested.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How would I change it, if I wanted to?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can do it yourself in the Airtel Thanks app under 'Plans', or visit the store with your ID. There's no charge for changing plans.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me think about it and ask my daughter.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course, ma'am, take your time. The offer is available all month. Thank you and have a nice day.

source: authored for evaluation (paraphrased from public advisories)
